# 2-Day Singapore Family Plan

Compact, low-walking plan for **2 adults + 1 child (8)** with a **SGD 450 total budget excluding hotel**. I’ve prioritized air-conditioned breaks, short taxi rides, and rain-safe backups.

## Family Itinerary: 14–15 Aug 2026

### Day 1: Marina Bay + Indoor Science Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Start at **Gardens by the Bay – Cloud Forest / Flower Dome** for an indoor, stroller-friendly cool-down.
- **Afternoon:** Short taxi to **Marina Bay Sands / Merlion area** for an outdoor photo stop and easy waterfront stroll; keep it brief in the heat.
- **Food:** **Hainanese chicken rice** or **fried rice/noodles** at a nearby mall food court; easy for a child and budget-friendly.
- **Transport estimate:** 2 taxi/Grab hops + MRT backup = **SGD 20–35**
- **Rain backup:** Spend longer inside **Cloud Forest + Flower Dome** and add **ArtScience Museum** if everyone still has energy.

Action: [Button: Gardens Tickets](https://www.gardensbythebay.com.sg/en/attractions/cloud-forest.html)

### Day 2: Zoo-Style Outdoor Morning + Indoor Escape
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Choose **Singapore Zoo** for the main outdoor activity; go early, use the tram where possible, and focus on a few zones only.
- **Afternoon:** Head to an **air-conditioned mall** nearby for lunch, rest, and a simple indoor activity like a **children’s discovery play area** or **museum**.
- **Food:** **Chicken rice, tofu/veg rice, or curry rice** from a food court; add fruit juice or ice cream for the child.
- **Transport estimate:** Taxi/Grab to zoo + return + mall transfer = **SGD 30–45**
- **Rain backup:** Swap the zoo for **S.E.A. Aquarium** or **ArtScience Museum** and keep the afternoon indoors.

Action: [Button: Zoo Info](https://www.mandai.com/en/singapore-zoo.html)

## Budget Check

| Item | Estimated Cost (SGD) | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Gardens by the Bay entry | 30–60 | Depends on combo choice and child pricing |
| Outdoor attraction entry | 0–50 | Merlion area is free; zoo costs more |
| Indoor backup activity | 25–45 | Museum or aquarium-style option |
| Transport | 50–80 | Mostly taxis/Grab to reduce walking |
| Meals | 90–140 | Hawker/food court meals, drinks, snacks |
| Buffer | 60–120 | For ice cream, extra ride, or surprise costs |

## Best Fit for Your Budget

- **Most budget-safe version:** Gardens by the Bay + Merlion + hawker meals + **free outdoor stop** + indoor mall backup
- **Best kid-focused version:** Gardens by the Bay + Singapore Zoo + food court meals
- **Best rain-proof version:** Gardens by the Bay + ArtScience Museum + S.E.A. Aquarium or mall play area
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f3/ArtScience_Museum%2C_Marina_Bay_Sands%2C_Singapore.jpg Alt=Best rain-proof version:** Gardens by the Bay + ArtScience Museum + S.E.A. Aquarium or mall play area, Singapore

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: MRT Planner](https://www.sgtrains.com/)
Action: [Button: Visit Singapore](https://www.visitsingapore.com/)
Action: [Button: Weather Check](https://www.weather.gov.sg/)

- Mandai Wildlife Reserve / Singapore Zoo: https://www.mandai.com/en.html
- Singapore weather and rain outlook: https://www.weather.gov.sg/
